description: Verify keyset pagination returns next batch after cursor
setupSql:
CREATE TABLE products (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(50), price NUMERIC, created_at VARCHAR(20));
INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Laptop', 1000, '2026-01-01'), (2, 'Phone', 800, '2026-01-02'), (3, 'Tablet', 500, '2026-01-03');
expectedOutputSql: SELECT id, name, price, created_at FROM products WHERE (created_at, id) < ('2026-01-03', 3) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20;
